newsitem.title: USA: Safeskin gets $21 million glove contract.
newsitem.headline: Safeskin gets $21 million glove contract.

text.p: Safeskin Corp Tuesday said it has been awarded a three-year contract to supply its examination gloves to Catholic Materials Management Alliance, a St. Louis based Group Purchasing Organization representing approximately 230 healthcare facilities in the United States.
In a statement the company said the total value of the contract over its three-year term is estimated at $21 million.
Safeskin will be the sole contracted supplier of exam gloves to CMMA members beginning March 1, 1997, through February 28, 2000.
